prompt: Our UIKit video player needs a diagnostic view showing which audio tracks declare audio description, which captions and audio are currently selected, and the asset duration. It must not change the user's selections or start playback. Some items have no alternate tracks, some are not loaded yet, and loading can fail. Please show an iOS 26+ implementation using supported APIs and local unit tests. How would you tell what the metadata establishes, and what it cannot tell us about the content?
